comparison.objective: Tip and push a loaded wheelchair over a kerb; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1175 tests coordinated tipping-lever force, rolling, balance, and staged traversal; candidate tests small-tool alignment, collar adjustment, locking, and repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1175 requires complete kerb traversal while retaining the dummy and forbids excessive pitch or lifting; candidate requires bounded damper travel and retained setting. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Whole-body mobility manipulation does not duplicate precision mechanical commissioning.
